scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide city street with tall buildings on both sides, featuring a mix of old and new architecture, including a large beige building with many windows and balconies, and a smaller brown building with a flat roof and a few windows. The street is lined with trees and has a pedestrian crossing marked by white lines and a blue sign reading 'TAXI' in white letters. People are walking along the sidewalk, some carrying bags or pushing strollers, while others sit on benches or stand near the street. A few cars drive down the street, and a bus stop is visible in the distance. The sky is overcast with clouds.
scene_analysis.buildings: The beige building has a curved corner and a flat roof, with several stories of windows and balconies. It is made of stone or concrete and has a decorative cornice at the top. The building next to it is shorter and has a more modern design, with a flat roof and a few windows. There are also several other buildings in the background, including a tall skyscraper with a pointed roof.
scene_analysis.materials: The beige building has a smooth, textured facade with a few decorative elements, such as carved stone carvings and ornate ironwork. The building next to it is made of brick and has a rougher texture, with a few windows and a small balcony.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk, as well as a few bicycles parked against the curb. A streetlight stands at the intersection, casting a warm glow over the area.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The trees lining the street are tall and leafy, providing shade for pedestrians and adding a touch of greenery to the urban landscape. There are also several potted plants and flowers along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs along the street, including a large blue sign reading 'TAXI' in white letters. There are also several smaller signs indicating bus stops and directions.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: People are walking in all directions, some carrying bags or pushing strollers. There are also several cyclists riding bikes along the sidewalk.
